Dice Have No Eyes is a dice-rolling Balatro-like fever dream about greed management.

Every roll carries a chance for glory.

But every roll carries a risk of bust.

Improve and swap your dice with each cleared level.

Collect trinkets and discover broken synergies.

WHAT'S THERE

  • 100+ trinkets

  • 40+ spells and snacks

  • RNG powered by God n' Fate engine

  • Magic dice effects

  • 5 companions with unique powers

  • Pretty decent art

  • Dice with no eyes whatsoever

  • Advanced tickle mechanic technology

  • Night mode for your poor tired eyes

WHAT'S TO COME

  • More trinkets, spells, snacks

  • New dreamy worlds to play in

  • More playable characters and silly shopkeepers

  • Challenge runs and run modifiers

  • An entity claiming to be God

  • Strait of Hormuz resolution

  • Dares and quests

  • Music sourced straight from starving indie musicians

  • Infinite Mode?



Made by two guys
